report.summary: Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A quoted both sides at a constant 391 per order and re-quoted about every 1-10 s. Every order is far below the depth, and cancels are symmetric across sides. The only fills were on the trader's own BUY quotes, and there was no opposite-side execution. The detector's 'BUY execution of 58' was a partial fill of the trader's own resting bid O-00008763. The cancel of the 391 SELL was the paired re-quote. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.93. This is a proposal only, and a human analyst makes the decision.

**The three facts that drove it:**
1. T-MM-01 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It re-quoted a BUY and a SELL of 391 together about every 1–10 seconds, and cancel_symmetry is 0.997. The largest order is 0.16 times depth, and no single order reached 3 times depth.
2. The "BUY execution of 58" was a partial fill of the trader's own resting bid O-00008763. Opposite-side fill quantity is 0, and same-side fills were 449, all before any opposite trade. So there was no benefit from an opposite-side execution.
3. There was no price move or reversion to measure, no repetition of the cycle (repetitions_in_session is 0), no public event and no risk event in the window.

**What would change my mind:** an opposite-side execution by this trader at a price a one-sided resting order had moved, followed by a reversion. A single order of 3 times depth or more would also change it.
